source_message:
test(compliance): emergency stop integration tests — 17/17 T-01..T-17

Tests cover I-23 (stop checked before every decision) and I-24 (audit trail):
  T-01..T-04  Idle status, activate response, validation (operator_id/reason required)
  T-05..T-08  I-23: all 4 screening endpoints return 503 while stop active
              (screen/person, screen/company, screen/wallet, transaction/check)
  T-09..T-11  Resume idempotency, validation (mlro_id/resume_reason required)
  T-12        Full lifecycle: activate → 503 → MLRO resume → 200
  T-13        Fail-open: Redis + filesystem both unavailable → 200, not 503
  T-14..T-15  Status endpoint reflects active state correctly
  T-16        Idempotent activate: double-activate still blocks screening
  T-17        Resume response contains previous stop metadata (audit trail I-24)

Architecture: in-memory Redis stub + /tmp stop file + all external deps mocked
Runs fully on Legion (no GMKtec, no /data, no redis package needed)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
